scenes.line1: Why do apps fail at go-live?
scenes.say: Most onboarding delays are network issues. What’s the one checklist that prevents go-live failures?

scenes.label: Matrix
scenes.sub: Build a flow matrix: source, destination, port, protocol, why.
scenes.say: Start with a flow matrix. List every connection, its source, destination, port, protocol and purpose.
Every row in your matrix must be allowed at each traffic filter: on-prem, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, NSG and host firewall.

scenes.title: DNS Setup Example
scenes.say: DNS matters too. Use internal records for private access, public records if needed, and private DNS zones for endpoints.

scenes.question: What’s the biggest onboarding trap?
scenes.right: Not building a flow matrix. Without it, you miss rules, approvals and troubleshooting steps.
scenes.say: The biggest trap? Skipping the flow matrix. You’ll miss rules, approvals and troubleshooting steps.
